_notes: Isa 49:12: Latin 'terra australi' (southern land) rendered as 南地 following the directional sense; 思高 has 息宁 (Sinim/Aswan region) but the Vulgate differs — used 南地 to match Vulgate sense and flag for review. Isa 38:10-24: The Vulgate canticle has 24 verses vs. 思高's 22 verses; the Vulgate splits verses differently. Latin 38:11 'Quæsívi resíduum annórum meórum' (I sought the remainder of my years) is merged into v.11 as a preamble. Latin 38:12 'Non aspíciam hóminem ultra' maps to the second part of 思高 v.11; rendered by sense. Latin 38:15 'Sperábam usque ad mane / quasi leo contrívit' maps to 思高 v.13 (哀号/狮子). Latin 38:16 begins 'De mane usque ad vésperam' (repeated refrain) then 'sicut pullus hirúndinis' maps to 思高 v.14. Latin 38:19 'Recogitábo tibi' rendered combining 思高 v.15 sense. Latin 38:20 maps to 思高 vv.16-17. Latin 38:24 'psalmos nostros' rendered as 圣歌 (liturgical songs) following context; 思高 v.20 has 絃琴 (lyre/harp) but the Vulgate text says 'psalmos'. Canticum Ezechiæ: 'Ezechiæ' is genitive of Ezechias (Hezekiah) → 希则克雅; Canticum Ezechielis: 'Ezechielis' is genitive of Ezechiel (Ezekiel) → 厄则克耳 — distinct persons; flagged for disambiguation.
